purpose: Expose authored structural office modules with their own collision and the current office-floor composition.
state_owner: Blood textures, render marks, surface anchors, lifetime and density budgets
Authored lamp power, color, flicker phase, fixture shape and body visibility; derived runtime light activation
Planner blood decorations: texture, surface and size
Authored display power/content/seed, derived screen surfaces, runtime power, glow and contiguous television walls
Item weight catalogue and character push/kick rules
Environment prop visual stages and physical reactions; durability rules owned by features.combat
Mission-local decorative neighboring skyline geometry and facade material
Positional server fan ambience and its lifetime
Mission-local bounded mixed-material floor debris textures, source cache, stamp queue and density

mission_wiring_v1.configure_player: configure_player(actor: Node3D) -> void on structural roots

planner_light_v1.set_authored_color: set_authored_color(color: Color) -> void; RGB tint, alpha fixed to 1
planner_light_v1.configure_fixture: configure_fixture(shape: String, visible_in_game: bool) -> void; shape point|linear|rectangle; body visibility independent of emitted light

planner_decor_v1.configure_blood: configure_blood(texture_id: String, surface: String) -> void; surface floor|wall

occlusion_visual_v1.camera_occluder: Structural public scene roots carry camera_occluder; render classification only, not a service locator.

display_v1.has_display: has_display() -> bool; visible screens only; closed laptops excluded
display_v1.configure_display: configure_display(config: Dictionary {power: on|off|auto, content: static|dynamic, seed: int}) -> void; TV content always dynamic
display_v1.get_display_config: get_display_config() -> Dictionary; exported authored config, never transient damage
display_v1.configure_displays: configure_displays(wall: Node) -> void; explicit mission-local display_wall registration

planner_decor_v2.blood: configure_blood(texture, surface), configure_blood_normal(Vector3), get_blood_config() -> {texture, surface: floor|wall|object, normal: Array[float]}
planner_decor_v2.attachment: attach_blood(anchor, stable_owner_id), configure_blood_attachment({owner, mesh}), get_blood_attachment(); follows mesh, hides on destruction; restored by bootstrap using stable object id
planner_decor_v2.configure_projection: configure_projection(anchor: Node3D) -> void; clipped multi-receiver blood in every renderer, optional mission-wiring collaborator

damage_particles_v1.configure_damage_particles: configure_damage_particles(enabled: bool) -> void; repeated electronics sparks only

display_placement_v1.get_display_edges: get_display_edges() -> Dictionary {frame: Transform3D, size: Vector2}; empty when not a frameless TV
display_placement_v1.snap_display_edges: snap_display_edges(neighbors: Array[Dictionary]) -> void; .18m, coplanar edges only

prop_weight_v1.push_from_character: push_from_character(character_position: Vector3, movement: Vector3, strength: float = 1.0) -> void; movement is the intended pre-slide velocity, weight-limited push
prop_weight_v1.weight_kg: weight_kg: float on environment and physical props; RigidBody mass unchanged
prop_weight_v1.kickable: items <= 2 kg and <= 0.45 m high use layer value 4/mask 7, never block characters and are kicked by touching CharacterBody3D feet
prop_weight_v1.shots: every bullet hit pushes a loose (not frozen) prop by weapon momentum / weight_kg, max 3.2 m/s per hit, at the hit point; grenades push through their blast

surface_decor_v1.table_finish: 07_table_longest: Modern_Warm_White surfaces -> chocolate wood, Modern_Graphite -> graphite; per-surface overrides survive fragments
surface_decor_v1.document_print: flat paper models get one random document (6 atlas documents x 2 orientations) draped over the top sheet; not persisted
surface_decor_v1.stickers: monitors get 0-3 sticky notes at distinct screen-edge slots, chosen from the persisted display seed; no DTO change

blood_exit_v1.splatter_exit: splatter_exit(point: Vector3, direction: Vector3, energy: float, excluded: Array[RID]) -> void; optional queued surface projection for a confirmed projectile exit; bounded three-ray fan and floor fallback

runtime_contracts.prepared_placement_v1: Public environment_prop accepts optional planning_settled_transform metadata before ready; skips legacy conference-chair grounding for prepared maps/bakes. Collision/damage/mass ownership unchanged (ADR0055).

glass_floor_debris_v1.configure_glass_debris: configure_glass_debris(floor_view: Node3D) -> void on glass_partition and environment_prop; bootstrap injects the existing public base_floor_renderer
glass_floor_debris_v1.floor: scatter_glass_debris(panes: Array[MeshInstance3D], direction: Vector3), stamp_glass_debris(at: Vector2, frame: int, size: float, turns: int = 0) -> bool; positions are floor-local XZ; clear_glass_debris() clears transient pixels
glass_floor_debris_v1.budgets: 8m/512px sections; sixteen shared RGBA8+R8 image/texture pairs; 64 queued stamps; two stamps and one section upload (color + roughness) per active frame; four stamps per 1m cell; least-recently-written eviction; about 40 MiB CPU+GPU section storage. No added physics or debris nodes.

floor_debris_v2.configure: Existing configure_glass_debris(floor_view: Node3D) injection also configures material debris on environment_prop, paper_prop, staged_table, physical_prop/table and scaled_destructible roots; local scene roots forward it.
floor_debris_v2.scatter: scatter_prop_debris(at: Vector3, footprint: Vector2, recipe: Array[String], direction: Vector3, excluded: Array[RID] = []) -> void; at and footprint are floor-local XZ, direction world-space; at most twelve stamps per event; rays exclude the source collision.
floor_debris_v2.stamp: stamp_material_debris(at: Vector2, kind: String, frame: int, size: float, turns: int = 0) -> bool; floor-local XZ, kind glass|paper|wood|cardboard|plastic|fabric|extinguisher; old stamp_glass_debris remains compatible.
floor_debris_v2.lifetime: All kinds share glass_floor_debris_v1 budgets and clear_glass_debris; transient, not persisted. Per prop at most four distinct actual destruction facts; rare table red addition once; extinguisher only on rupture.
floor_debris_v2.surface: Compact R8 roughness accompanies RGBA8 atlas pixels; last visible fragment determines roughness at overlaps. Shared original resources stay immutable.
